title: Parodies of Munch's "Scream"
content: Edvard Munch's 1895 pastel "The Scream" sold last night at Sotheby's in New York for $120 million, setting a record for the most expensive piece of art ever sold at auction. The sale eclipsed the previous record of $106 million for Picasso's "Nude, Green Leaves, and Bust."Like theMona Lisa,American Gothic, or any other iconic image, The Scream has spawned countless parodies. The ones above are byArvid Andreassen,Erro,Mad Minerva, andIhansenRead more....13 Coolest Mona Lisa ParodiesAmerican Gothic Parody BlogBBC report on sale of Munch's Scream
